from common import *
import shutil
def main():
 source(TMP/'common.py');source(__file__)
 import numpy as np,pandas as pd,qlib,yaml
 from qlib.data import D
 from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import blend_score_series
 from backtest.scripts.register.experiment_registry import load_registry
 from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import _validate_metadata
 rows=load_registry(REGISTRY)
 current=next(r for r in reversed(rows) if r.get('phase_m_protocol')=='v1' and r.get('current_baseline') is True)
 btcurrent=next(r for r in reversed(rows) if r.get('report_kind')=='phase_m_v1_bt_baseline' and r.get('current_bt') is True)
 assert current['exp_id']=='regime-adapt/m0-h20-t5h5-es-v1'
 assert btcurrent['exp_id']=='baseline/phase-m-v1-bt-v5'
 assert not any(r.get('baseline_version')=='v5' for r in rows)
 for state in [PREV/'docs/harness-state.json',STUDY/'docs/harness-state.json']:
  r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'backtest/scripts/maintenance/experiment_harness.py'),'status','--state',str(state)],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
  assert json.loads(r.stdout)['status']=='closed'
 proof=read(PREV/'docs/predictions-quantile10-old.json');assert proof['variant']=='quantile10' and proof['treatment']=='old'
 assert [x['seed'] for x in proof['components']]==SEEDS
 predictions=[]
 for c in proof['components']:
  for key in ['model','prediction','training']:check(c[key])
  m=read(ROOT/'backtest/result'/c['session']/'meta.json')
  assert m['session_name']==c['session'] and m['regime_adapt']['seed']==c['seed']
  train=read(ROOT/c['training']['path']);assert train['variant']=='quantile10' and train['treatment']=='old'
  pred=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/c['prediction']['path']).iloc[:,0]
  assert pred.index.is_unique and np.isfinite(pred.to_numpy()).all()
  if predictions:assert pred.index.equals(predictions[0].index)
  predictions.append(pred)
 check(proof['ensemble']);ens=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/proof['ensemble']['path']).iloc[:,0];rebuilt=blend_score_series(predictions)
 assert ens.index.equals(rebuilt.index) and np.array_equal(ens.to_numpy(),rebuilt.to_numpy())
 prepared=read(PREV/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')['variants']['quantile10'];check(prepared['old'])
 metric=read(PREV/'metrics/quantile10-old.json');primary=metric['pools']['all']['ensemble']['head']['3']['5']
 assert primary['n_days']==1448 and abs(primary['net_ann']-.32050695390856143)<1e-12
 assert metric['data_version']=='2026-11-03' and metric['label_window_cutoff']['h5']=='2026-07-23'
 qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
 actual_date=str(pd.Timestamp(D.calendar()[-1]).date());assert actual_date==metric['data_version']
 for folder in [MB,BT]:
  for name in ['configs','metrics','reports','docs','data']:(folder/name).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 shutil.copyfile(PREV/'metrics/quantile10-old.json',MB/'metrics/model-evaluation.json')
 shutil.copyfile(PREV/'configs/evaluation.yaml',MB/'configs/evaluation.yaml')
 profile={'structure':'每个种子一个单LightGBM，沿用H20／patience50冻结超参。','features':'Alpha158 + range，164列，无regime特征。','training_sample':{'pool':'沪深全A','time_range':'2004-01-02～2020-07-31','filters':'沿用已完成H20稳定性复核的冻结特征、训练日期、M0权重和有效标签掩码；5,448,963条有序训练样本，原件与签名见来源清单。'},'training_target':'旧标签快照H20累计收益，按日截面等样本10档；并列组按中秩归档，同档标签相同。ordinal0..9经冻结仿射变换，scale='+str(prepared['scale'])+'，offset='+str(prepared['offset'])+'；不在分档后重新CSRankNorm。','evaluation_sample':{'pool':'全A','time_range':'2020-08-03～2026-07-31；H5退出截断至2026-07-23，1448日','filters':'日频ST、成交额≥1000万、上市≥60日；头部另剔t+1不可成交。'},'early_stopping':'Top5×H5扣费净年化，eval_window，patience=50，上限200轮；采用完整退出边界。','prediction_signal':'固定五种子逐日截面z-score后等权合成；官方主格Top3×H5，全局H5 RankIC。','changes':'2026-11-07用户指定把旧标签等样本n=10晋升为v5；复用原五种子，不重训。','model_paths':[{'path':c['model']['path'],'seed':c['seed']} for c in proof['components']]}
 for path,eid,kind,title in [(MB,MODEL_ID,'model','等样本10档 · H20／patience50（v5）'),(BT,BT_ID,'strategy','v5 等样本10档 · 真阶梯Top3×H5')]:
  meta={'schema_version':2,'entity_type':'experiment','kind':kind,'track':'all_a','exp_id':eid,'archive_path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'title':title,'inventory_kind':'asset_snapshot'}
  if kind=='model':meta.update(experiment_type='training_target',model_profile=profile,benchmark_outputs=[{'ref':MODEL_ID,'version':'v5'}])
  else:meta.update(model_ref=MODEL_ID,comparison_baseline={'ref':'baseline/phase-m-v1-bt-v5','version':'s5'})
  _validate_metadata(ROOT,path/'metadata.json',meta,kind);write(path/'metadata.json',meta)
 write(MB/'configs/model-manifest.json',{'model_ref':MODEL_ID,'baseline_version':'v5','label_source':'old','seeds':SEEDS,'components':proof['components'],'ensemble':proof['ensemble'],'source_parent':'training-target/label-grading-p50-20261106-v1','source_candidate':'quantile10-old','selection_study':'training-target/quantile-n-p50-20261107-v1','source_proof':fp(PREV/'docs/predictions-quantile10-old.json'),'evaluation':fp(MB/'metrics/model-evaluation.json'),'label_transform':prepared,'profile':profile})
 write(MB/'docs/promotion-plan.json',{'user_instruction':'将n=10晋升为模型的新baseline，并且跑一次真阶梯回测，跟回测baseline对比效果。','authorized_by':'user','authorized_at':'2026-11-07','new_model_ref':MODEL_ID,'new_model_version':'v5','previous_model_ref':current['exp_id'],'previous_model_version':'v2','selected_label_source':'old','source_fit_count':5,'new_fits':0,'prior_research_fits':176,'model_promotion_independent_of_derived_backtest_result':True,'scope':'Research model baseline only. BT baseline remains s5; production/deployment not authorized by this request.','temporary_directory':str(TMP),'steps':['Verify five actual models/predictions and exact ensemble','Append v5/current selection and preserve v2 history; update current model definition','Freeze two fixed account recipes: v5×Top3H5 true ladder and v5×s5 rule control','Run serially without retraining or tuning, compare official s5 plus matched-rule control','Verify metrics, register, rebuild model/BT reports, clean exact task-owned temporary artifacts']})
 write(MB/'docs/promotion-verification.json',{'at':time.time(),'models_verified':5,'predictions_verified':5,'ensemble_exact':True,'source_proof':fp(PREV/'docs/predictions-quantile10-old.json'),'evaluation':fp(MB/'metrics/model-evaluation.json'),'source_label':prepared['old'],'actual_provider_calendar_last':actual_date,'provider_calendar':fp(PROVIDER/'calendars/day.txt'),'official_primary':primary,'old_model_selection':current,'bt_baseline_selection':btcurrent})
 write(BT/'docs/baseline-record.json',btcurrent)
 for rule,oldname in [('ladder','derived-ladder-k3h5.yaml'),('s5','fixed-s5.yaml')]:
  cfg=yaml.safe_load((HORIZON/'configs'/oldname).read_text());cfg['run']['note']='quantile10_v5_'+rule
  (BT/'configs'/f'{rule}.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(cfg,allow_unicode=True,sort_keys=False))
 print(json.dumps({'verified_models':5,'ensemble_exact':True,'provider_date':actual_date,'primary':primary,'tmp':str(TMP)},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
